description:
Discover the magic of the holidays as we take you through San Diego’s most festive Christmas lights neighborhoods! Bring the whole family and enjoy an evening filled with lights, music, and holiday cheer — a December experience you won’t want to miss.

​Our Holiday Lights & Coastal Tour visits three iconic and beautifully decorated neighborhoods:
🎄 Chula Vista Christmas Circle
🎄 Christmas Card Lane
🎄 The Famous Christmas House
Walk through dazzling displays, charming decorations, and joyful holiday scenes — perfect for photos, family fun, and making new memories.
Cozy up with holiday music, festive snacks, and the warm spirit of the season as our team guides you through the best Christmas spots in the city.

itinerary:
5:45 PM – Check-In & BoardingGuests check in at their designated pick-up point. Our team welcomes you with holiday cheer, music, and instructions for the evening.
Please arrive 15 minutes early.

6:00 PM – Depart San DiegoBoard our comfortable Five Star Tours vehicle as we begin our holiday journey. Enjoy classic Christmas music and light narration from your guide.

6:20 PM – Chula Vista Christmas CircleOur first stop is the beloved Christmas Circle in Chula Vista — a neighborhood famous for its decades-long tradition of elaborate light displays.
✨ Walk through the streets
✨ Take festive photos
✨ Enjoy cookies & candies provided onboard

7:10 PM – Christmas Card LaneNext, we visit the iconic Christmas Card Lane, where every house is decorated with oversized wooden “Christmas cards,” lights, inflatables, and family-themed displays.
Perfect for photos and a fun stroll with friends and family.

8:00 PM – The Famous Christmas HouseOur final stop is the spectacular Christmas House, known citywide for its dazzling lights, synchronized music, animated decorations, and magical holiday spirit.
Guests enjoy free time to walk, admire the decorations, and capture magical holiday memories.

8:40 PM – Return JourneyRelax on the comfortable ride back to San Diego while enjoying soft Christmas music.

9:00 PM – Arrival in San DiegoDrop-off at the original location with warm hearts, bright smiles, and the holiday spirit in full swing.

faqs:
1. What time does the tour start and end?
The tour departs at 6:00 PM and returns at approximately 9:00 PM. Guests must check in 15 minutes before departure.

2. Where do we meet for the tour?
Pick-up is available from select central San Diego locations. Your exact meeting point will be confirmed via email 24 hours before your tour.

3. How many neighborhoods do we visit?
We visit three of San Diego’s most iconic Christmas lights neighborhoods:

Chula Vista Christmas Circle

Christmas Card Lane

The Famous Christmas House

4. Is there walking involved?
Yes. Each stop includes short walks to view holiday lights and decorations. Please wear comfortable shoes.

5. Is this tour family-friendly?
Absolutely! This is a family-friendly experience and great for all ages.

6. What should we bring?
Warm clothing (evenings can be chilly), comfortable shoes, a camera or phone, and holiday spirit!

7. Are snacks included?
Yes! We provide cookies and candies as festive holiday treats. Additional snacks or meals are not included.

8. Are restrooms available?
Restrooms may be available at some locations, but guests should plan ahead since the neighborhoods are residential.

9. What happens if it rains?
Light rain will not cancel the tour. In the rare event that unsafe weather or neighborhood closures occur, we will notify you and offer a full refund.

10. Is gratuity included?
Gratuities for the guide and driver are not included, but are appreciated for excellent service.
